question: What is the meaning of expected lifetime in relation to general information?
description: The expected lifetime, or CIUse, represents the potential functional lifespan of a product compared to the average life span of status-quo products in the same application. It is calculated as the ratio of the product's potential lifespan (L) to the industry average lifespan (Lav) of the building layer the product is applied in. The actual score is determined by calculating the weighted average of all products from various system layers. This indicator helps assess the sustainability of a product's design and usage.
